x: After Terry Newell, Randy Glenn and Peter Pepe had run we were abreast of Blackheath, a good 15 yards clear of the remainder. Although he had run a half-mile heat and final during the afternoon, John Thresher took last stage.
Randy Glenn, Terry Newell and Alan Jackson produced a blanket finish for 2nd, 3rd and 4th, all recording 51.5. The hardest fought race of the day was the Senior 880 yards.
